Storey heights,taper,overhang,porch dimensions,column offsets,roof curve,tile sizes,wall thickness and bracket details are photo-relative estimates.
The42.65total and7.85finial come from separate official chapter conventions;34.80roofapex is an explicit derived modelling assumption, not a common-datum measurement.
The historical177survivingbrackets and exact preservation epochs are not claimed by the simplified visible support construction; rear and obscured form follows stated symmetry.
Five reference photos remain unchanged licensed source images; color material estimates do not embed or bake photograph pixels, shadows or current weathering.
Fangta has open annular iron hoops with supports, not a solid Longhua-style drum. Exact small yoke/bell/chain ornament details remain schematic.
